title: The Hepatitis C Transplant Collaborative
official: Nationwide Hepatitis C NAT+ Cardiac Transplant Experience
summary: In this study we seek to test the hypothesis that safety and clinical outcomes after cardiac transplantation utilizing HCV NAT+ donor organs as currently performed are acceptable.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Recipient of a proven HCV NAT+ donor heart.
2. Re-transplant patients will be included.

Exclusion Criteria:

1\. Multi-organ transplantation
